params.constraint: a < b && c < d && b != d && gcd(a, b) == 1 && gcd(c, d) == 1
params.prompt: Hasil dari {a}/{b} + {c}/{d} × {e} dalam bentuk paling sederhana adalah …

distractors.num: ((a * d + b * c) * e) / gcd((a * d + b * c) * e, b * d)
distractors.den: (b * d) / gcd((a * d + b * c) * e, b * d)

distractors.num: (a + c * e) / gcd(a + c * e, b + d)
distractors.den: (b + d) / gcd(a + c * e, b + d)

distractors.num: (a * d + c * e) / gcd(a * d + c * e, b * d)
distractors.den: (b * d) / gcd(a * d + c * e, b * d)

distractors.num: (a * d + b * c) / gcd(a * d + b * c, b * d * e)
distractors.den: (b * d * e) / gcd(a * d + b * c, b * d * e)
